usage: Illustrative homemade dishes, not photographs of the user's actual meals. Both crepe variants intentionally share an illustration with different fillings.

images.subject: A bowl of Polish clear chicken broth rosół with fine egg noodles and a few thin cooked carrot slices. Clear golden soup, restrained parsley garnish. No big meat chunks.
An entire Italian homemade thin crust pizza with tomato sauce, melted mozzarella and sliced salami. No extra vegetables.

Three thin Polish crêpes naleśniki folded into triangles on a plate, one showing a thin layer of chocolate hazelnut filling and another showing strawberry jam. No powdered sugar, no cream, no fruit garnish.
Polish cheesecake with a cocoa shortcrust base and cocoa crumble, creamy Pilos bucket-curd filling, no raisins.
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square food photograph thumbnail for a dark navy-blue Polish nutrition diary. Primary request: a generous rectangular slice of Polish baked cheesecake sernik królewski, with a thick smooth ivory twaróg curd-cheese filling, dark cocoa shortcrust base and irregular crumbly dark cocoa crumble on top. Absolutely no raisins, fruit, chocolate glaze, cream or garnish. A few natural cocoa crumbs beside the slice are fine. Use fresh Polish bucket cheesecake curd, baked to a firm creamy ivory interior; avoid American cream-cheese cheesecake styling. Composition: single slice centered on a complete round ivory ceramic dessert plate, top-down with just enough angle to see the filling layers clearly, clean margins, close enough to remain recognizable at 64px. Background: plain dark charcoal navy tabletop matching a dark blue nutrition app. Soft natural food-photography lighting, realistic appetizing homemade textures. No props, utensils, napkins, people, hands, text, logos or watermark. Generate one square image, not a collage.
